data.strFullDescription:
Experience Tales of Xillia, remastered for the first time ever.

Dive into the magnificent world of Rieze Maxia as either Jude Mathis, an aspiring medical student from the capital, or Milla Maxwell, a mysterious woman accompanied by four powerful spirits.

Worlds Collide, Destiny Awaits

[h2]• Two Heroes, One Destiny[/h2]
[imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2246670/extras/f1e0dc65802a810e2a3402e24d263268.poster.avif?t=1761903995" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2246670/extras/f1e0dc65802a810e2a3402e24d263268.webm?t=1761903995" width="780" height="324"][/imgvid]
Follow the paths of Milla and Jude as they embark on their daring journey through Rieze Maxia, a wondrous land where mankind and spirits coexist in harmony.

[h2]• Partner Up with Dual Raid[/h2]
[imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2246670/extras/0ef78fd441d830bcc35e0af70f1aa04c.poster.avif?t=1761903995" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2246670/extras/0ef78fd441d830bcc35e0af70f1aa04c.webm?t=1761903995" width="780" height="324"][/imgvid]
Master the Dual Raid Linear Motion Battle System, mustering strategy and coordination to overcome action-packed battles in real-time combat. Team up with allies to unleash devastating combo attacks and unlock special support skills to overwhelm your foes.

[h2]• Witness the Dramatic Story with High-Quality Animation[/h2]
[imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2246670/extras/e6e036fe5f1cd92c64f197eae50a93a7.poster.avif?t=1761903995" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2246670/extras/e6e036fe5f1cd92c64f197eae50a93a7.webm?t=1761903995" width="780" height="324"][/imgvid]
Visit the gorgeous Rieze Maxia, revitalized by beautifully-rendered illustrations and animations.

[h2]• Quality of Life Upgrades[/h2]
[imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2246670/extras/c28ffd1ab8754056608406ea6e41534a.poster.avif?t=1761903995" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2246670/extras/c28ffd1ab8754056608406ea6e41534a.webm?t=1761903995" width="780" height="324"][/imgvid]
Explore with new quality-of-life updates including improved graphics, an auto-save feature, the ability to toggle encounters, early shop access, and more.

[h2]• An All-Around Experience[/h2]
[imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2246670/extras/d76eb0146ee268c25b98a65c7e2d54a7.poster.avif?t=1761903995" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2246670/extras/d76eb0146ee268c25b98a65c7e2d54a7.webm?t=1761903995" width="780" height="324"][/imgvid]
Xillia Remastered contains DLC launched alongside the original release, including costumes, useful items, and other fun extras.
